name: great-mosque-of-djenne
description: Asymmetric earth mosque footprint with open western courtyard, three tapered qibla towers on east facade, softened buttresses, palm toron scaffolding and clay-capped roof vents; raised flood plinth.
attribution: Survey plans © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0. Architectural geometry originally authored for Vearth.

audit.dimension_uncertainty: Horizontal perimeter and courtyard are measured provider rings. Wall/tower elevations, toron spacing, roof vents and softened mud profiles are interpretations of AKTC restoration drawings and exterior photographs; no flat-roof mosque template is used.
audit.orientation: Source footprints in east/north metric coordinates; all component rotations baked into vertices.
audit.grounding: Fixed production sampled datum with narrow lower-only cuts under authored masonry; no whole-site terrain flattening.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
license: repository LICENSE; reference images and plans are not embedded textures
